149    protected StructuredMySQLConfig(@NotNull Class<T> clazz, @NotNull InetSocketAddress address, @NotNull String database, @NotNull String table, @Nullable String username, @Nullable String password, boolean useMariadb, @NotNull Duration cacheLength, @NotNull ObjectProcessor processor) {

167    /**
168     * Get if the config is loaded
169     *
170     * @return If the config is loaded
171     *
172     * @since 1.0.0
173     */
174    @Override
175    public boolean getLoaded() {
176        if (this.config == null) {
177            return false;
178        }
179
180        return Instant.now().isBefore(this.configExpires);
181    }

183    /**
184     * Get if the driver is connected
185     *
186     * @return If the driver is connected
187     *
188     * @since 3.5.0
189     */
190    public boolean getConnected() {
191        try {
192            return this.connection != null && this.connection.isValid(1);
193        } catch (SQLException e) {
194            throw new MySQLException(e);
195        }
196    }

198    /**
199     * Act as if the config was just fetched, sets the expiration time to {@link #cacheLength} into the future.
200     *
201     * @since 5.0.1
202     */
203    public void revalidateCache() {
204        this.configExpires = Instant.now().plus(this.cacheLength);
205    }

207    /**
208     * Connect to the server
209     *
210     * @throws IOException On connect error
211     * @since 1.0.0
212     */
213    public void connect() throws IOException {
214        synchronized (SAVELOAD_LOCK) {
215            try {
216                Properties properties = new Properties();
217                properties.put("characterEncoding", "utf8");
218                if (this.username != null) {
219                    properties.put("user", this.username);
220
221                    if (this.password != null) {
222                        properties.put("password", this.password);
223                    }
224                }
225
226                try {
227                    if (this.useMariadb) {
228                        Class.forName("org.mariadb.jdbc.Driver");
229                    } else {
230                        Class.forName("com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver");
231                    }
232                } catch (ClassNotFoundException e) {
233                    throw new DriverLoadException(e);
234                }
235
236                this.connection = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:" + (this.useMariadb ? "mariadb:" : "mysql:") + "//" + this.address.getHostString() + ":" + this.address.getPort() + "/" + this.database, properties);
237
238                if (this.connection.isValid(3)) {
239                    this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
240
241                    MySQLHelper.execute(this.connection, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS " + this.table + " (path varchar(256) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, type varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, value varchar(4096) CHARACTER SET utf8, PRIMARY KEY (path)) CHARACTER SET utf8;");
242
243                    try (ResultSet result = MySQLHelper.query(this.connection, "DESCRIBE " + this.table + ";")) {
244                        boolean typeExists = false;
245
246                        while (result.next()) {
247                            String name = result.getString("Field");
248                            if ("type".equals(name)) {
249                                typeExists = true;
250                            }
251                        }
252
253                        if (!typeExists) {
254                            MySQLHelper.execute(this.connection, "ALTER TABLE " + this.table + " ADD COLUMN type varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL AFTER path;");
255
256                            MySQLHelper.execute(this.connection, "UPDATE " + this.table + " SET type='STRING';");
257                        }
258                    } catch (SQLException e) {
259                        throw new IOException(e);
260                    }
261                } else {
262                    if (this.connection != null) {
263                        this.connection.close();
264                    }
265
266                    throw new IOException("Failed to connect: Connection is not valid");
267                }
268            } catch (SQLException e) {
269                throw new IOException(e);
270            }
271        }
272    }
273
274    /**
275     * Load the config
276     *
277     * @param save Weather to save the config after loaded (To update the template)
278     *
279     * @throws IOException On load error
280     * @since 1.3.0
281     */
282    @Override
283    public void load(boolean save) throws IOException {
284        if (this.closed) {
285            throw new ConfigClosedException();
286        }
287
288        while (!this.getConnected()) {
289            this.reconnectAttempts++;
290
291            try {
292                this.connect();
293            } catch (IOException e) {
294                try {
295                    Thread.sleep((int) (Math.pow(2, this.reconnectAttempts) * 1000));
296                } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
297                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
298                }
299            }
300
301            if (this.reconnectAttempts > 5) {
302                throw new MaximumReconnectsException();
303            }
304        }
305        assert this.connection != null;
306
307        synchronized (SAVELOAD_LOCK) {
308            ParsedObject object = ParsedObject.create();
309
310            try (ResultSet result = MySQLHelper.query(this.connection, "SELECT path,type,value FROM " + this.table)) {
311                while (result.next()) {
312                    String path = result.getString("path");
313                    String type = result.getString("type").toUpperCase();
314                    ParsedPrimitive.PrimitiveType primitiveType = ParsedPrimitive.PrimitiveType.valueOf(type);
315                    String value = result.getString("value");
316
317                    ParsedElement element = ParsedPrimitive.from(ParsedPrimitive.fromString(value).to(primitiveType));
318
319                    PathResolver.updateElement(object, path, element, true);
320                }
321            } catch (SQLException e) {
322                throw new IOException(e);
323            }
324
325            this.config = this.processor.toObject(object, this.clazz);
326            this.configExpires = Instant.now().plus(this.cacheLength);
327
328            this.configBackup = object;
329        }
330
331        if (save) {
332            this.save();
333        }
334    }
335
336    /**
337     * Save the config to the server
338     *
339     * @throws IOException On save error
340     * @since 1.0.0
341     */
342    @Override
343    public void save() throws IOException {
344        if (this.closed) {
345            throw new ConfigClosedException();
346        }
347        if (this.config == null || this.configBackup == null) {
348            throw new ConfigNotLoadedException();
349        }
350
351        while (!this.getConnected()) {
352            this.reconnectAttempts++;
353
354            try {
355                this.connect();
356            } catch (IOException e) {
357                try {
358                    Thread.sleep((int) (Math.pow(2, this.reconnectAttempts) * 1000));
359                } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
360                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
361                }
362            }
363
364            if (this.reconnectAttempts > 5) {
365                throw new MaximumReconnectsException();
366            }
367        }
368        assert this.connection != null;
369
370        synchronized (SAVELOAD_LOCK) {
371            ParsedObject object = this.processor.toElement(this.config).asObject();
372            Set<String> keys = PathResolver.getKeys(object, false);
373            Set<String> oldKeys = PathResolver.getKeys(this.configBackup, false);
374
375            Set<String> toDelete = new HashSet<>(oldKeys);
376            toDelete.removeAll(keys);
377
378            List<String> queryArgs = new ArrayList<>();
379            for (String key : keys) {
380                ParsedElement valueElement = PathResolver.resolveElement(object, key);
381                ParsedElement oldValueElement = PathResolver.resolveElement(this.configBackup, key);
382
383                if (valueElement != null && oldValueElement != null) {
384                    ParsedPrimitive value = valueElement.asPrimitive();
385                    ParsedPrimitive oldValue = oldValueElement.asPrimitive();
386
387                    Object valueObj = value.get();
388                    Object oldValueObj = oldValue.get();
389
390                    if (!((value.isNull() && oldValue.isNull()) || (!value.isNull() && (valueObj == oldValueObj || valueObj.equals(oldValueObj))))) {
391                        queryArgs.add(key);
392                        queryArgs.add(value.getType().name());
393                        queryArgs.add(!value.isNull() ? valueObj.toString() : "null");
394                    }
395                }
396            }
397
398            this.configBackup = object;
399
400            try {
401                if (!queryArgs.isEmpty()) {
402                    MySQLHelper.executeBatch(this.connection, "REPLACE INTO " + this.table + " (path, type, value) VALUES (?, ?, ?);", 3, queryArgs);
403                }
404
405                if (!toDelete.isEmpty()) {
406                    MySQLHelper.executeBatch(this.connection, "DELETE FROM " + this.table + " WHERE path=?;", 1, List.copyOf(toDelete));
407                }
408            } catch (SQLException e) {
409                throw new IOException(e);
410            }
411        }
412    }
413
414    /**
415     * Close the config
416     *
417     * @throws IOException On close error
418     * @since 1.0.0
419     */
420    @Override
421    public void close() throws IOException {
422        if (this.closed) {
423            throw new ConfigClosedException();
424        }
425
426        this.closed = true;
427
428        try {
429            if (this.connection != null) {
430                this.connection.close();
431            }
432        } catch (SQLException e) {
433            throw new IOException(e);
434        }
435    }

438     * Get if the config is closed

441     *
442     * @since 1.0.0
443     */
444    public boolean isClosed() {
445        return this.closed;
446    }

847         * @param cacheLength How long to cache the config in memory
848         *
849         * @return Self for chaining
850         *
851         * @since 4.0.0
852         */
853        public @NotNull Builder<T> setCacheLength(@NotNull Duration cacheLength) {
854            this.cacheLength = cacheLength;
855            return this;
856        }
857
858        /**
859         * Set how long to cache the config in memory
860         * <p>
861         * Default is 1s

865         * @return Self for chaining
866         *
867         * @since 4.0.0

869         */
870        @Deprecated(since="5.0.0")
871        public @NotNull Builder<T> setCacheLength(long cacheLength) {
872            this.cacheLength = Duration.ofMillis(cacheLength);
873            return this;
874        }
875
876        /**
877         * Creating a new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.mysql.StructuredMySQLConfig}

883        public @NotNull StructuredMySQLConfig<T> build() {
884            return new StructuredMySQLConfig<>(this.clazz, this.address, this.database, this.table, this.username, this.password, this.useMariadb, this.cacheLength, this.processor);
